ticker_news.title: 2 Growth Stocks to Buy and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: The article discusses two growth stocks, Amazon and Chewy, that have strong positions in high-growth markets like e-commerce, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence. It suggests these stocks are good long-term investments due to their solid earnings prospects and competitive advantages.
ticker_news.author: Adria Cimino

ticker_news.title: Now Fresh: Safe & Festive Foods for Your Dog
ticker_news.description: Now Fresh Good Gravy™ is a new premium dog food featuring fresh meats, fruits, and vegetables. It can be served dry or mixed with water to create a hydrating bone broth gravy. The food is designed to provide a nutritious and flavorful meal for dogs, especially during the holiday season.

SPY.title: Worried About Buying Stocks Right Now? Follow This Advice from Warren Buffett.
SPY.description: The article discusses Warren Buffett's advice for investing in uncertain times, highlighting his recommendation to invest in S&P 500 index funds as a low-risk, long-term strategy. It also notes that while the overall market may appear expensive, some individual stocks still represent good value.
SPY.author: Adria Cimino
